name: faithfulness-precision-spl-prompt-gpt-benchmarking
description: A benchmark dataset for measuring the faithfulness (precision) of LLM outputs to source information under prompting. It contains annotations that identify which model-generated statements are grounded in the provided evidence, enabling quantitative assessment of factual precision and error types. Used to compare prompting strategies and model variants on how reliably they produce veridical claims.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented dataset used in studies of LLM faithfulness; recognized within the faithfulness/QA research community but not a mainstream benchmark.
